defect.problem: The authority exists as a precedential Third Circuit slip opinion, but the inventory assertion marks official_citation_present=true even though the lake record says no official citation has been assigned and the case is slip-only.
defect.proposed_fix: Retain the slip citation but set official_citation_present=false, or otherwise distinguish docket/slip citation from an official reporter citation.

reasons: The lake identity record matches United States v. Ryan Mendoza, No. 25-1154, Third Circuit, decided 2026-01-08.

residual_risks: Treatment remains unverified, so the disclosed record does not establish a completed current citator check.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use a slip-only citation flag and avoid calling the slip/docket citation an official citation.
